rollforward.distributable_income_opening_verbatim: Amount to be distributed to Stapled Securityholders at beginning of the year | 134,789
rollforward.net_distributable_income_verbatim: Income available for distribution to Stapled Securityholders for the year | 256,708
rollforward.distribution_cash_paid_verbatim: Distributions to Stapled Securityholders during the year: - 3.550 cents (1 Jul 2024 to 31 Dec 2024) (134,764); - 2.526 cents (1 Jan 2025 to 30 Jun 2025) (96,483) | subtotal (231,247)
rollforward.distributable_income_closing_verbatim: Amount to be distributed to Stapled Securityholders at end of the year | 137,050
rollforward.distribution_paid_declared_verbatim: Income available for distribution 256,708 less Amount retained for asset enhancement initiatives and/or general corporate and working capital purposes (23,200) = 233,508 total distribution declared for FY2025 (DPS 6.10 cents); matches disclosed 'Total distribution was S$233.5 million' (p160/p116)
rollforward.notes: Source: audited Distribution Statement of CapitaLand Ascott Trust (Stapled Group, 2025 column), p116. A (opening carry) = 134,789; B (for-year income) = 256,708; P (cash distributions paid during the year) = 231,247 [= 3.550c 2H2024 tranche 134,764 + 2.526c 1H2025 tranche 96,483, tranches crossing fiscal years]; E (closing carry) = 137,050. B is the genuine for-year subtotal (327,614 total return attributable to SS & perp holders - 17,207 perp holders' share - 53,699 Note A distribution adjustments = 256,708); it does NOT fold in the opening carry. The TRAP line 'Distribution to Stapled Securityholders 391,497' (= 134,789 opening + 256,708 for-year) is the cumulative amount-available and was NOT used as B. GUARD: A + B - P = 160,250 != E (137,050); the 23,200 gap equals EXACTLY the separately-disclosed line 'Amount retained for asset enhancement initiatives and/or for general corporate and working capital purposes (23,200)'. Full disclosed rollforward reconciles precisely: 134,789 + 256,708 - 231,247(paid) - 23,200(retained) = 137,050 = E. guard_ok=false is driven solely by the disclosed retention reconciling item, NOT a mis-read line. distribution_paid_declared (233,508 = 256,708 - 23,200) is distinct from P (231,247 cash paid) because the 3.576c 2H2025 tranche declared for FY2025 was paid on 27 Feb 2026 (after FYE) while the 3.550c 2H2024 tranche was paid in FY2025. All figures in SGD thousands scaled to units.
